'''Ruso Zin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he was working for the [[Lady of Pain]], a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Exchange]] operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and brought her the news that her captive [[Gault Rennow|Tyresius Lokai]] had escaped.<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruso Zin appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" />
